history.summary: An unusually large 1,302 sqft 2BR at just $913 psf (17% below the $1,102 median) for under $1.19M, sitting 460m from Choa Chu Kang MRT/JRL interchange with a strong 7.3%/yr resale CAGR on 112 transactions. The defining risk is age: 1998 build on a 1995 lease, leaving roughly 68 years — within a decade of the 60-year financing cliff. Low absolute price and JRL catalyst make it interesting, but the lease decay caps the verdict.
history.rating_rationale: The price and PSF look outstanding (913 vs 1,102 median, sub-$1.2M, 1,302 sqft), the txn sample is robust (112) and CCK gets the Jurong Region Line (~2028) plus interchange status — all genuine positives. But the 99-yr lease commenced 1995, so ~68 years remain in 2026; by a 5-7 year exit the buyer faces a ~61-63 year lease nearing the 60-year financing/CPF restriction threshold, which structurally compresses the future buyer pool and is the real reason the PSF is so low. The high historical CAGR partly reflects a low base, not durable quality. D23 is OCR with a ~3.7% baseline; the catalyst helps but does not erase lease decay. Balanced — a value play with a hard ceiling.

history.summary: A real PSF discount on a large unit beside CCK MRT, but accelerating lease decay (~68yrs left), 1998 vintage and a mis-tagged bed count offset the cheapness.
history.rating_rationale: Asking 928 psf sits below the project's entire last-12-month range (966-1198 psf, avg ~1098), so the algo's -16.6% age and -15.7% cohort discounts are real against recent resale evidence (21-txn cohort is reasonable). It is OCR D23 next to Choa Chu Kang MRT/Lot One. However the value is materially offset by lease risk: 99yr from 1995 leaves only ~68 years, where decay and financing/CPF restrictions begin to bite (low_lease and very_old_property flags are genuine, not quirks). The bedroom_sqft_mismatch is explained — a 1055 sqft unit is not a true 1BR but a mis-tagged larger (likely 3BR) layout, so the listing metadata is unreliable and must be re-verified. Cheapness real but lease-shortened: a Neutral hold, not a buy, until the lease/exit math is confirmed for a 5-7yr horizon.
red_flags: Only ~68 years lease remaining (99yr from 1995) — lease decay and CPF/financing limits will weigh on resale within the hold window
bedroom_sqft_mismatch: 1055 sqft tagged as 1-bed is almost certainly a mis-tagged 3BR — listing metadata unreliable, verify actual layout
1998 build (very_old_property) implies aging facilities and higher maintenance
catalysts: Adjacent to Choa Chu Kang MRT (NSL + LRT) and Lot One mall — strong everyday convenience
Verified PSF below the recent transaction range gives entry-price cushion
